# Legacy explicit variable producers

These fixtures contain compiled modules, CSS, and contracts generated by Zyzz commit `466814fde0b6d582998a5da85e36759b23b7ab49`, before readable explicit variable names.

The version 30 fixture was generated by commit `de21e04` after readable explicit variable names.

All producers export `palette = Vars.define({ color: { ink: '#ff0000' } }, { id: 'legacy/palette' })` and a style whose `backgroundColor` references `palette.color.ink`. The version 29 and 30 producers also derive a composed `faded` color from `ink` and reference that color in the style. These outputs verify that the compiler rejects old variable names with a rebuild diagnostic.
